chunks.text: I’m going to be around Beijing later, and I keep thinking about how parking is always a mess there.
Then after that I’m heading to Shanghai, and I’m leaning toward just getting a car while I’m there so I’m not stuck juggling rides all day.
For that Beijing evening, I’m planning to leave the car at Zhongguancun Plaza Parking starting 2026-04-08 17:00.
It’ll be for about 12 hours, and the plate is 浙E34567.

And for the Shanghai stretch I’m set on a Toyota Corolla, picking it up on 2026-05-09 for 4 days—name’s Luo Fei—and I’ll probably just use 13822334455 for the driver phone, since that’s the one I always have on me, and then I was thinking about where to head first after I grab the keys…
